$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0125-transfer-degenerate.xml, transcribed element by element from the XML bytes - NOT produced by e142DocumentToJson (Rule 10, D-030). Task 12's negative case, and it is two cases in one document. First: a T carrying NONE of its six attributes - all of FX, FY, FID, TX, TY, TID are use="optional" and none is coupled, so an empty T is schema-valid and names neither end, which is E142_XML_TRANSFER_EMPTY. Second: a TransferMap missing one of the three From* attributes the XSD declares use="required" - together they are an intra-document keyref, so a missing one leaves the source unidentifiable, which is E142_XML_TRANSFER_FROM_MISSING. Both are warnings, not errors, and the second TransferMap being well formed shows one degenerate map does not poison its siblings. In JSON an empty T is the empty object {}: the member is present and carries nothing, which is exactly what <T/> says.
